get.summary: Retrieve a line item group by Id

parameters.description: Unique company identifier associated with the Procore User Account.

x-changelog.summary: Introducing new endpoint to get a line item group by Id
x-changelog.description: This endpoint allows retrieving a line item group by its Id.

Python3
x-code-samples.content:
import http.client

conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection("api.procore.com")

conn.request("GET", "/rest/v2.0/companies/%7Bcompany_id%7D/estimating/bid_board_projects/%7Bbid_board_project_id%7D/proposals/%7Bproposal_id%7D/line_item_groups/%7Bline_item_group_id%7D")

res = conn.getresponse()
data = res.read()

print(data.decode("utf-8"))
